THE WORKSHEET GENERATOR

Tracing sheet maker.

Letters, numbers, class words — and the proudest name in the house. Trace on paper, or trace with a finger right on the screen.

Build the sheet

One solid example to read, dashed letters to follow, then a blank line to try alone.

What are we tracing?
Which shape?

Trace it with a finger ✎

Follow the dashed shape with a finger, a mouse or a stylus — then clear it and try again.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Each row reads the same way: one solid example to look at, dashed shapes to follow, and a blank stretch of line to try alone. The finger-tracing pad under the sheet is for practice that costs no paper — nothing is scored, and the Clear button forgives everything. Print gives a full A4 or US Letter sheet, and the picture button saves a PNG. For name practice, type your child’s name once and shuffle as many sheets as you like; the words shelf follows our classes, from Class 36 animals to Class 33 helpers.
